experiment3.local_timings: local_steps.csv: operation timers exclude startup; CPU uses process_time_ns
experiment3.zk_timings: steps.csv: command elapsed times include process/container startup
experiment3.local_workload: N independent transfers, amount=1, N pending SQLite transactions; 2N or fixed account count
experiment3.local_storage: isolated run files, buffered writes without fsync; no L1 broadcast
experiment3.txpool_storage: one persistent WAL connection per pool; atomic insert+hash per add; synchronous=NORMAL
experiment3.txpool_shutdown: pool closed at worker exit, outside per-operation timers
experiment3.local_resources: per-operation CPU and wall only; wrapper CPU/RSS/IO in steps.csv include startup
experiment3.limits: stage dominance is not identification of a physical resource bottleneck

memory_measurement.quantity: sum of process-tree RSS; shared pages may be counted more than once
memory_measurement.zeros: included at startup/exit; entirely unobserved command is null
memory_measurement.phase: sequential step distributions pooled within each repetition; gaps between steps excluded
memory_measurement.repetitions: equal-weight summary of successful, measured repetitions; counts exported
memory_measurement.system_scope: process RSS distribution unavailable for containers; legacy peak may use system delta
